answer: Keeping 175 aliases alive as a result means 175 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the lantern quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the shale log reveals the live set and the river audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 460 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
